export default "---\ntitle: \"React Hooks深度解析\"\nexcerpt: \"深入解析React Hooks的原理、使用方法和最佳实践，帮助开发者全面掌握这一革命性特性，提升React组件开发效率和代码质量\"\ncoverImage: \"/assets/blog/preview/cover.jpg\"\ndate: \"2025-11-27\"\nauthor:\n  name: 小羽\n  picture: \"/assets/blog/authors/jj.jpeg\"\nogImage:\n  url: \"/assets/blog/preview/cover.jpg\"\n---\n\n# React Hooks深度解析\n\n## 前言\n\nReact Hooks是React 16.8引入的一项革命性特性，它彻底改变了我们编写React组件的方式。Hooks让我们能够在不编写class的情况下使用state和其他React特性，使函数组件拥有了与类组件同等的能力，同时提供了更简洁、更直观的代码组织方式。本文将深入解析React Hooks的原理、使用方法和最佳实践，帮助你全面掌握这一强大的特性。\n\n## Hooks基础概念\n\n### 为什么需要Hooks\n\n在Hooks出现之前，React组件主要分为类组件和函数组件两种：\n\n```javascript\n// 类组件 - 复杂且冗长\nclass Counter extends React.Component {\n  constructor(props) {\n    super(props)\n    this.state = {\n      count: 0\n    }\n    this.increment = this.increment.bind(this)\n    this.decrement = this.decrement.bind(this)\n  }\n  \n  increment() {\n    this.setState(prevState => ({\n      count: prevState.count + 1\n    }))\n  }\n  \n  decrement() {\n    this.setState(prevState => ({\n      count: prevState.count - 1\n    }))\n  }\n  \n  componentDidMount() {\n    document.title = `Count: ${this.state.count}`\n  }\n  \n  componentDidUpdate() {\n    document.title = `Count: ${this.state.count}`\n  }\n  \n  render() {\n    return (\n      <div>\n        <h1>Count: {this.state.count}</h1>\n        <button onClick={this.increment}>+</button>\n        <button onClick={this.decrement}>-</button>\n      </div>\n    )\n  }\n}\n\n// 函数组件 + Hooks - 简洁直观\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'\n\nfunction Counter() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    document.title = `Count: ${count}`\n  }, [count])\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>Count: {count}</h1>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>+</button>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count - 1)}>-</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\nHooks解决了以下问题：\n\n1. **组件间逻辑复用困难**：高阶组件和render props模式会导致组件树嵌套过深\n2. **复杂组件难以理解**：生命周期方法中包含不相关的逻辑\n3. **类组件的this指向问题**：需要绑定this，容易出错\n4. **类与函数的混淆**：机器和人类都难以理解类组件\n\n### Hooks使用规则\n\nHooks有两个重要的使用规则，必须遵守：\n\n```javascript\n// 规则1：只能在函数最顶层调用Hooks\n// 不要在循环、条件或嵌套函数中调用Hook\nfunction MyComponent() {\n  // ✅ 正确：在顶层调用\n  const [name, setName] = useState('React')\n  \n  if (name !== '') {\n    // ❌ 错误：在条件语句中调用Hook\n    const [age, setAge] = useState(25)\n  }\n  \n  function handleClick() {\n    // ❌ 错误：在嵌套函数中调用Hook\n    const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  }\n  \n  return <div>{name}</div>\n}\n\n// 规则2：只能在React函数中调用Hooks\n// 不要在普通JavaScript函数中调用Hook\nfunction myCustomFunction() {\n  // ❌ 错误：在普通JavaScript函数中调用Hook\n  const [state, setState] = useState(0)\n}\n\n// ✅ 正确：在React函数组件中调用Hook\nfunction MyComponent() {\n  const [state, setState] = useState(0)\n  return <div>{state}</div>\n}\n\n// ✅ 正确：在自定义Hook中调用Hook\nfunction useMyCustomHook() {\n  const [state, setState] = useState(0)\n  return [state, setState]\n}\n```\n\n## 核心Hooks详解\n\n### useState Hook\n\nuseState是最基本的Hook，用于在函数组件中添加状态。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useState } from 'react'\n\n// 基本用法\nfunction Counter() {\n  // useState返回一个数组：[当前状态, 更新状态的函数]\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0) // 0是初始值\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Count: {count}</p>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 使用函数初始化状态\nfunction UserProfile({ userId }) {\n  // 如果初始状态需要通过计算得出，可以使用函数\n  const [user, setUser] = useState(() => {\n    // 这个函数只会在初始渲染时执行一次\n    return fetchUser(userId)\n  })\n  \n  return <div>{user.name}</div>\n}\n\n// 状态更新可以是对象\nfunction Form() {\n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({\n    username: '',\n    email: '',\n    password: ''\n  })\n  \n  const handleChange = (e) => {\n    const { name, value } = e.target\n    \n    // 更新对象状态时，需要合并旧状态\n    setFormData(prevData => ({\n      ...prevData,\n      [name]: value\n    }))\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <form>\n      <input\n        type=\"text\"\n        name=\"username\"\n        value={formData.username}\n        onChange={handleChange}\n      />\n      <input\n        type=\"email\"\n        name=\"email\"\n        value={formData.email}\n        onChange={handleChange}\n      />\n      <input\n        type=\"password\"\n        name=\"password\"\n        value={formData.password}\n        onChange={handleChange}\n      />\n    </form>\n  )\n}\n\n// 状态更新是异步的\nfunction Counter() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  \n  const handleClick = () => {\n    // 直接基于当前状态更新可能会得到错误结果\n    setCount(count + 1) // 基于count=0更新为1\n    setCount(count + 1) // 仍然基于count=0更新为1\n    \n    // 使用函数式更新确保基于最新状态\n    setCount(prevCount => prevCount + 1) // 基于最新状态更新\n    setCount(prevCount => prevCount + 1) // 基于最新状态更新\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Count: {count}</p>\n      <button onClick={handleClick}>Increment Twice</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n### useEffect Hook\n\nuseEffect用于处理副作用，如数据获取、订阅、手动更改DOM等。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'\n\n// 基本用法 - 每次渲染后执行\nfunction DocumentTitle() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  \n  // 每次渲染后都会执行\n  useEffect(() => {\n    console.log('Component rendered')\n    document.title = `Count: ${count}`\n  })\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Count: {count}</p>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 依赖数组 - 只在依赖项变化时执行\nfunction DocumentTitleWithDeps() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  const [name, setName] = useState('React')\n  \n  // 只在count变化时执行\n  useEffect(() => {\n    console.log('Count changed')\n    document.title = `Count: ${count}`\n  }, [count]) // 依赖数组\n  \n  // 只在组件挂载时执行一次\n  useEffect(() => {\n    console.log('Component mounted')\n    // 相当于componentDidMount\n  }, [])\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Count: {count}</p>\n      <p>Name: {name}</p>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>\n      <button onClick={() => setName('Vue')}>Change Name</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 清理函数 - 在组件卸载或下次effect执行前运行\nfunction Timer() {\n  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    console.log('Setting up timer')\n    \n    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {\n      setSeconds(prevSeconds => prevSeconds + 1)\n    }, 1000)\n    \n    // 返回清理函数\n    return () => {\n      console.log('Cleaning up timer')\n      clearInterval(intervalId)\n    }\n  }, []) // 空依赖数组表示只在挂载和卸载时执行\n  \n  return <div>Seconds: {seconds}</div>\n}\n\n// 数据获取\nfunction UserProfile({ userId }) {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  const [error, setError] = useState(null)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const fetchUser = async () => {\n      try {\n        setLoading(true)\n        const response = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/users/${userId}`)\n        const data = await response.json()\n        setUser(data)\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(err.message)\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n    \n    fetchUser()\n  }, [userId]) // 当userId变化时重新获取数据\n    \n  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  if (error) return <div>Error: {error}</div>\n  if (!user) return <div>No user found</div>\n  \n  return <div>{user.name}</div>\n}\n\n// 订阅和取消订阅\nfunction WindowSize() {\n  const [windowSize, setWindowSize] = useState({\n    width: window.innerWidth,\n    height: window.innerHeight\n  })\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleResize = () => {\n      setWindowSize({\n        width: window.innerWidth,\n        height: window.innerHeight\n      })\n    }\n    \n    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)\n    \n    // 清理函数：移除事件监听器\n    return () => {\n      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize)\n    }\n  }, []) // 空依赖数组，只在挂载和卸载时执行\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      Width: {windowSize.width}, Height: {windowSize.height}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n### useContext Hook\n\nuseContext用于在组件树中跨层级共享数据，避免props逐层传递。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react'\n\n// 创建Context\nconst ThemeContext = createContext()\n\n// 提供者组件\nfunction App() {\n  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light')\n  \n  return (\n    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>\n      <Toolbar />\n    </ThemeContext.Provider>\n  )\n}\n\n// 中间组件不需要传递props\nfunction Toolbar() {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <ThemedButton />\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 消费者组件\nfunction ThemedButton() {\n  // 使用useContext获取Context值\n  const { theme, setTheme } = useContext(ThemeContext)\n  \n  const style = {\n    backgroundColor: theme === 'dark' ? '#333' : '#FFF',\n    color: theme === 'dark' ? '#FFF' : '#333',\n    padding: '10px',\n    border: '1px solid'\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <button style={style} onClick={() => setTheme(theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')}>\n      Toggle Theme\n    </button>\n  )\n}\n\n// 多个Context\nconst UserContext = createContext()\nconst ThemeContext = createContext()\n\nfunction App() {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState({ name: 'John' })\n  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light')\n  \n  return (\n    <UserContext.Provider value={{ user, setUser }}>\n      <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>\n        <Profile />\n      </ThemeContext.Provider>\n    </UserContext.Provider>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction Profile() {\n  // 可以同时使用多个Context\n  const { user } = useContext(UserContext)\n  const { theme } = useContext(ThemeContext)\n  \n  return (\n    <div style={{ color: theme === 'dark' ? 'white' : 'black' }}>\n      Hello, {user.name}!\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 优化：使用自定义Hook封装Context\nfunction useUser() {\n  const context = useContext(UserContext)\n  if (context === undefined) {\n    throw new Error('useUser must be used within a UserProvider')\n  }\n  return context\n}\n\nfunction useTheme() {\n  const context = useContext(ThemeContext)\n  if (context === undefined) {\n    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider')\n  }\n  return context\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction Profile() {\n  const { user } = useUser()\n  const { theme } = useTheme()\n  \n  return (\n    <div style={{ color: theme === 'dark' ? 'white' : 'black' }}>\n      Hello, {user.name}!\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n### useReducer Hook\n\nuseReducer是useState的替代方案，用于处理更复杂的状态逻辑。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useReducer } from 'react'\n\n// 基本用法\nconst initialState = { count: 0 }\n\nfunction reducer(state, action) {\n  switch (action.type) {\n    case 'increment':\n      return { count: state.count + 1 }\n    case 'decrement':\n      return { count: state.count - 1 }\n    case 'reset':\n      return { count: action.payload }\n    default:\n      throw new Error()\n  }\n}\n\nfunction Counter() {\n  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initialState)\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      Count: {state.count}\n      <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'decrement' })}>-</button>\n      <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'increment' })}>+</button>\n      <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'reset', payload: 0 })}>Reset</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 复杂状态管理\nconst initialState = {\n  loading: false,\n  error: null,\n  data: null\n}\n\nfunction apiReducer(state, action) {\n  switch (action.type) {\n    case 'fetch':\n      return { ...state, loading: true, error: null }\n    case 'success':\n      return { ...state, loading: false, data: action.payload }\n    case 'error':\n      return { ...state, loading: false, error: action.payload }\n    default:\n      return state\n  }\n}\n\nfunction DataFetcher({ url }) {\n  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(apiReducer, initialState)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const fetchData = async () => {\n      dispatch({ type: 'fetch' })\n      \n      try {\n        const response = await fetch(url)\n        const data = await response.json()\n        dispatch({ type: 'success', payload: data })\n      } catch (error) {\n        dispatch({ type: 'error', payload: error.message })\n      }\n    }\n    \n    fetchData()\n  }, [url])\n  \n  if (state.loading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  if (state.error) return <div>Error: {state.error}</div>\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <pre>{JSON.stringify(state.data, null, 2)}</pre>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 惰性初始化\nfunction init(initialCount) {\n  return { count: initialCount }\n}\n\nfunction Counter({ initialCount = 0 }) {\n  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initialCount, init)\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      Count: {state.count}\n      <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'reset', payload: initialCount })}>\n        Reset\n      </button>\n      <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'increment' })}>+</button>\n      <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'decrement' })}>-</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## 高级Hooks详解\n\n### useCallback Hook\n\nuseCallback用于缓存函数，避免不必要的重新创建。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react'\n\n// 基本用法\nfunction ParentComponent() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  \n  // 每次渲染都会创建新的函数\n  const handleClickWithoutCallback = () => {\n    console.log('Button clicked')\n  }\n  \n  // 使用useCallback缓存函数\n  const handleClickWithCallback = useCallback(() => {\n    console.log('Button clicked')\n  }, []) // 空依赖数组，函数不会改变\n  \n  // 带依赖的useCallback\n  const handleClickWithValue = useCallback(() => {\n    console.log(`Count is ${count}`)\n  }, [count]) // 当count变化时，函数会重新创建\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Count: {count}</p>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>\n      <ChildComponent onClick={handleClickWithCallback} />\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 优化子组件渲染\nconst ChildComponent = React.memo(({ onClick }) => {\n  console.log('ChildComponent rendered')\n  return <button onClick={onClick}>Child Button</button>\n})\n\n// 实际应用场景：事件处理器\nfunction TodoList() {\n  const [todos, setTodos] = useState([\n    { id: 1, text: 'Learn React', completed: false },\n    { id: 2, text: 'Write Code', completed: false }\n  ])\n  \n  // 使用useCallback优化事件处理器\n  const handleToggle = useCallback((id) => {\n    setTodos(prevTodos =>\n      prevTodos.map(todo =>\n        todo.id === id ? { ...todo, completed: !todo.completed } : todo\n      )\n    )\n  }, [])\n  \n  const handleDelete = useCallback((id) => {\n    setTodos(prevTodos => prevTodos.filter(todo => todo.id !== id))\n  }, [])\n  \n  return (\n    <ul>\n      {todos.map(todo => (\n        <TodoItem\n          key={todo.id}\n          todo={todo}\n          onToggle={handleToggle}\n          onDelete={handleDelete}\n        />\n      ))}\n    </ul>\n  )\n}\n\nconst TodoItem = React.memo(({ todo, onToggle, onDelete }) => {\n  return (\n    <li>\n      <input\n        type=\"checkbox\"\n        checked={todo.completed}\n        onChange={() => onToggle(todo.id)}\n      />\n      <span style={{ textDecoration: todo.completed ? 'line-through' : 'none' }}>\n        {todo.text}\n      </span>\n      <button onClick={() => onDelete(todo.id)}>Delete</button>\n    </li>\n  )\n})\n```\n\n### useMemo Hook\n\nuseMemo用于缓存计算结果，避免重复计算。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react'\n\n// 基本用法\nfunction ExpensiveCalculation({ a, b }) {\n  // 使用useMemo缓存计算结果\n  const result = useMemo(() => {\n    console.log('Performing expensive calculation...')\n    // 模拟耗时计算\n    let result = 0\n    for (let i = 0; i < 1000000; i++) {\n      result += a * b\n    }\n    return result\n  }, [a, b]) // 只有当a或b变化时才重新计算\n  \n  return <div>Result: {result}</div>\n}\n\nfunction Calculator() {\n  const [a, setA] = useState(10)\n  const [b, setB] = useState(20)\n  const [counter, setCounter] = useState(0)\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <div>\n        <input value={a} onChange={e => setA(Number(e.target.value))} />\n        <input value={b} onChange={e => setB(Number(e.target.value))} />\n      </div>\n      \n      <ExpensiveCalculation a={a} b={b} />\n      \n      <div>\n        <p>Counter: {counter}</p>\n        <button onClick={() => setCounter(counter + 1)}>Increment Counter</button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 实际应用场景：过滤和排序\nfunction UserList({ users, filter, sortBy }) {\n  // 使用useMemo缓存过滤和排序结果\n  const filteredAndSortedUsers = useMemo(() => {\n    console.log('Filtering and sorting users...')\n    \n    let result = [...users]\n    \n    // 过滤\n    if (filter) {\n      result = result.filter(user =>\n        user.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase())\n      )\n    }\n    \n    // 排序\n    if (sortBy) {\n      result.sort((a, b) => {\n        if (sortBy === 'name') {\n          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name)\n        } else if (sortBy === 'age') {\n          return a.age - b.age\n        }\n        return 0\n      })\n    }\n    \n    return result\n  }, [users, filter, sortBy])\n  \n  return (\n    <ul>\n      {filteredAndSortedUsers.map(user => (\n        <li key={user.id}>\n          {user.name} (Age: {user.age})\n        </li>\n      ))}\n    </ul>\n  )\n}\n\n// 使用useMemo缓存复杂对象\nfunction Chart({ data, options }) {\n  // 缓存图表配置对象\n  const chartOptions = useMemo(() => ({\n    ...options,\n    responsive: true,\n    plugins: {\n      legend: {\n        position: 'top',\n      },\n      title: {\n        display: true,\n        text: 'Chart Title'\n      }\n    }\n  }), [options])\n  \n  // 缓存图表数据\n  const chartData = useMemo(() => ({\n    labels: data.map(item => item.label),\n    datasets: [\n      {\n        label: 'Dataset',\n        data: data.map(item => item.value),\n        backgroundColor: 'rgba(54, 162, 235, 0.2)',\n        borderColor: 'rgba(54, 162, 235, 1)',\n        borderWidth: 1\n      }\n    ]\n  }), [data])\n  \n  return <div>Chart with options and data</div>\n}\n```\n\n### useRef Hook\n\nuseRef用于获取DOM元素引用或在多次渲染之间保存可变值。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react'\n\n// 获取DOM元素引用\nfunction TextInputWithFocusButton() {\n  const inputEl = useRef(null)\n  \n  const onButtonClick = () => {\n    // `current` 指向已挂载到 DOM 上的文本输入元素\n    inputEl.current.focus()\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <input ref={inputEl} type=\"text\" />\n      <button onClick={onButtonClick}>Focus the input</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 保存可变值\nfunction Timer() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  const intervalRef = useRef()\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {\n      setCount(prevCount => prevCount + 1)\n    }, 1000)\n    \n    return () => {\n      clearInterval(intervalRef.current)\n    }\n  }, [])\n  \n  const handleStop = () => {\n    clearInterval(intervalRef.current)\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Count: {count}</p>\n      <button onClick={handleStop}>Stop Timer</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 获取上一轮的props或state\nfunction usePrevious(value) {\n  const ref = useRef()\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    ref.current = value\n  })\n  \n  return ref.current\n}\n\nfunction Counter() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  const prevCount = usePrevious(count)\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>Now: {count}, before: {prevCount}</h1>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook中使用useRef\nfunction useInterval(callback, delay) {\n  const savedCallback = useRef()\n  \n  // 保存最新的callback\n  useEffect(() => {\n    savedCallback.current = callback\n  }, [callback])\n  \n  // 设置interval\n  useEffect(() => {\n    function tick() {\n      savedCallback.current()\n    }\n    \n    if (delay !== null) {\n      const id = setInterval(tick, delay)\n      return () => clearInterval(id)\n    }\n  }, [delay])\n}\n\nfunction Counter() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  \n  useInterval(() => {\n    setCount(count + 1)\n  }, 1000)\n  \n  return <h1>{count}</h1>\n}\n```\n\n## 自定义Hooks\n\n自定义Hooks是复用状态逻辑的强大方式，它遵循与内置Hooks相同的规则。\n\n### 创建自定义Hooks\n\n```javascript\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react'\n\n// 自定义Hook：数据获取\nfunction useFetch(url) {\n  const [data, setData] = useState(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  const [error, setError] = useState(null)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const fetchData = async () => {\n      try {\n        setLoading(true)\n        const response = await fetch(url)\n        const data = await response.json()\n        setData(data)\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(err.message)\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n    \n    fetchData()\n  }, [url])\n  \n  return { data, loading, error }\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction UserProfile({ userId }) {\n  const { data: user, loading, error } = useFetch(`https://api.example.com/users/${userId}`)\n  \n  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  if (error) return <div>Error: {error}</div>\n  if (!user) return <div>No user found</div>\n  \n  return <div>{user.name}</div>\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook：本地存储\nfunction useLocalStorage(key, initialValue) {\n  // 获取初始值\n  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState(() => {\n    try {\n      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key)\n      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(`Error reading localStorage key \"${key}\":`, error)\n      return initialValue\n    }\n  })\n  \n  // 更新值的函数\n  const setValue = (value) => {\n    try {\n      // 允许value是函数，类似useState\n      const valueToStore = value instanceof Function ? value(storedValue) : value\n      setStoredValue(valueToStore)\n      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(valueToStore))\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(`Error setting localStorage key \"${key}\":`, error)\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return [storedValue, setValue]\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction App() {\n  const [name, setName] = useLocalStorage('name', 'React')\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <input\n        type=\"text\"\n        value={name}\n        onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}\n      />\n      <p>Hello, {name}!</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook：防抖\nfunction useDebounce(value, delay) {\n  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handler = setTimeout(() => {\n      setDebouncedValue(value)\n    }, delay)\n    \n    return () => {\n      clearTimeout(handler)\n    }\n  }, [value, delay])\n  \n  return debouncedValue\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction SearchComponent() {\n  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('')\n  const debouncedSearchTerm = useDebounce(searchTerm, 500)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 使用防抖后的搜索词进行API调用\n    if (debouncedSearchTerm) {\n      console.log('Searching for:', debouncedSearchTerm)\n    }\n  }, [debouncedSearchTerm])\n  \n  return (\n    <input\n      type=\"text\"\n      value={searchTerm}\n      onChange={e => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}\n      placeholder=\"Search...\"\n    />\n  )\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook：窗口大小\nfunction useWindowSize() {\n  const [windowSize, setWindowSize] = useState({\n    width: window.innerWidth,\n    height: window.innerHeight\n  })\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleResize = () => {\n      setWindowSize({\n        width: window.innerWidth,\n        height: window.innerHeight\n      })\n    }\n    \n    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)\n    \n    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize)\n  }, [])\n  \n  return windowSize\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction WindowSizeComponent() {\n  const { width, height } = useWindowSize()\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      Window size: {width} x {height}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook：权限控制\nfunction useAuth() {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 检查用户是否已登录\n    const checkAuth = async () => {\n      try {\n        const token = localStorage.getItem('token')\n        if (token) {\n          const response = await fetch('/api/auth/me', {\n            headers: {\n              Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`\n            }\n          })\n          \n          if (response.ok) {\n            const userData = await response.json()\n            setUser(userData)\n          } else {\n            localStorage.removeItem('token')\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Auth check failed:', error)\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n    \n    checkAuth()\n  }, [])\n  \n  const login = async (credentials) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(credentials)\n      })\n      \n      if (response.ok) {\n        const { token, user } = await response.json()\n        localStorage.setItem('token', token)\n        setUser(user)\n        return { success: true }\n      } else {\n        const error = await response.json()\n        return { success: false, error: error.message }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      return { success: false, error: error.message }\n    }\n  }\n  \n  const logout = () => {\n    localStorage.removeItem('token')\n    setUser(null)\n  }\n  \n  return { user, loading, login, logout }\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction AuthComponent() {\n  const { user, loading, login, logout } = useAuth()\n  \n  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  \n  if (!user) {\n    return <LoginForm onLogin={login} />\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>Welcome, {user.name}!</h1>\n      <button onClick={logout}>Logout</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## Hooks最佳实践\n\n### 规则与约定\n\n```javascript\n// 1. 始终使用use前缀命名自定义Hook\nfunction useMyCustomHook() {\n  // Hook逻辑\n}\n\n// 2. 在多个组件间复用有状态逻辑\n// 而不是复用UI\nfunction useCounter(initialValue = 0) {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(initialValue)\n  \n  const increment = useCallback(() => setCount(c => c + 1), [])\n  const decrement = useCallback(() => setCount(c => c - 1), [])\n  const reset = useCallback(() => setCount(initialValue), [initialValue])\n  \n  return { count, increment, decrement, reset }\n}\n\n// 3. 将相关状态和逻辑组织在一起\nfunction useUserProfile(userId) {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  const [error, setError] = useState(null)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const fetchUser = async () => {\n      try {\n        setLoading(true)\n        const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`)\n        const userData = await response.json()\n        setUser(userData)\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(err.message)\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n    \n    if (userId) {\n      fetchUser()\n    }\n  }, [userId])\n  \n  const updateUser = useCallback(async (updates) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`, {\n        method: 'PATCH',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(updates)\n      })\n      \n      if (response.ok) {\n        const updatedUser = await response.json()\n        setUser(updatedUser)\n        return { success: true }\n      } else {\n        const error = await response.json()\n        return { success: false, error: error.message }\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      return { success: false, error: err.message }\n    }\n  }, [userId])\n  \n  return { user, loading, error, updateUser }\n}\n\n// 4. 使用条件渲染而不是条件Hook\n// 错误示例\nfunction BadComponent({ shouldUseFeature }) {\n  const [data, setData] = useState(null)\n  \n  if (shouldUseFeature) {\n    // 错误：在条件语句中使用Hook\n    const [featureData, setFeatureData] = useState(null)\n  }\n  \n  return <div>{data}</div>\n}\n\n// 正确示例\nfunction GoodComponent({ shouldUseFeature }) {\n  const [data, setData] = useState(null)\n  const [featureData, setFeatureData] = useState(null)\n  \n  // 在Hook内部使用条件逻辑\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (shouldUseFeature) {\n      // 获取featureData\n      fetchFeatureData().then(setFeatureData)\n    }\n  }, [shouldUseFeature])\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      {data}\n      {shouldUseFeature && featureData}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n### 性能优化\n\n```javascript\n// 1. 使用React.memo优化组件渲染\nconst ExpensiveComponent = React.memo(({ data, onClick }) => {\n  console.log('ExpensiveComponent rendered')\n  return (\n    <div>\n      {data.map(item => (\n        <div key={item.id} onClick={() => onClick(item.id)}>\n          {item.name}\n        </div>\n      ))}\n    </div>\n  )\n})\n\nfunction ParentComponent() {\n  const [data, setData] = useState([])\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  \n  // 使用useCallback缓存函数\n  const handleClick = useCallback((id) => {\n    console.log('Item clicked:', id)\n  }, [])\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <ExpensiveComponent data={data} onClick={handleClick} />\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment: {count}</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 2. 使用useMemo缓存计算结果\nfunction FilteredList({ items, filter }) {\n  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {\n    console.log('Filtering items...')\n    return items.filter(item => \n      item.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase())\n    )\n  }, [items, filter])\n  \n  return (\n    <ul>\n      {filteredItems.map(item => (\n        <li key={item.id}>{item.name}</li>\n      ))}\n    </ul>\n  )\n}\n\n// 3. 使用useReducer替代多个useState\nfunction complexReducer(state, action) {\n  switch (action.type) {\n    case 'setField':\n      return { ...state, [action.field]: action.value }\n    case 'reset':\n      return action.initialState\n    default:\n      return state\n  }\n}\n\nfunction useForm(initialState) {\n  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(complexReducer, initialState)\n  \n  const setField = useCallback((field, value) => {\n    dispatch({ type: 'setField', field, value })\n  }, [])\n  \n  const reset = useCallback(() => {\n    dispatch({ type: 'reset', initialState })\n  }, [initialState])\n  \n  return [state, setField, reset]\n}\n\nfunction MyForm() {\n  const [formData, setField, resetForm] = useForm({\n    username: '',\n    email: '',\n    password: ''\n  })\n  \n  const handleSubmit = (e) => {\n    e.preventDefault()\n    console.log(formData)\n    resetForm()\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\n      <input\n        value={formData.username}\n        onChange={e => setField('username', e.target.value)}\n        placeholder=\"Username\"\n      />\n      <input\n        value={formData.email}\n        onChange={e => setField('email', e.target.value)}\n        placeholder=\"Email\"\n      />\n      <input\n        value={formData.password}\n        onChange={e => setField('password', e.target.value)}\n        type=\"password\"\n        placeholder=\"Password\"\n      />\n      <button type=\"submit\">Submit</button>\n    </form>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## 总结\n\nReact Hooks彻底改变了我们编写React组件的方式，它提供了以下优势：\n\n1. **更简洁的代码**：函数组件比类组件更简洁，没有this绑定问题\n2. **更好的逻辑复用**：自定义Hooks提供了强大的逻辑复用机制\n3. **更清晰的关注点分离**：相关逻辑可以组织在一起，而不是分散在生命周期方法中\n4. **更好的类型推导**：TypeScript对Hooks的支持更好\n5. **更容易测试**：函数组件和Hooks更容易进行单元测试\n\n在使用Hooks时，应该遵循以下最佳实践：\n\n1. **遵守Hooks规则**：只在顶层调用Hooks，只在React函数中调用Hooks\n2. **合理使用useCallback和useMemo**：避免过度优化，只在必要时使用\n3. **创建自定义Hooks**：将复杂逻辑提取到自定义Hooks中\n4. **保持Hook简单**：每个Hook应该有单一职责\n5. **正确处理依赖数组**：确保依赖数组包含所有外部依赖\n\n通过深入理解React Hooks的原理和最佳实践，我们可以编写出更简洁、更高效、更可维护的React应用。"
